outcome: utilization of only TBA services in current pregnancy
reasons for use of TBA services
cohort: The cohort consisted of 347 pregnant women recruited from traditional birth attendant facilities in the Ikorodu Local Government Area, Lagos, Nigeria.
finding: All respondents had a positive perception of Traditional Birth Attendants (TBAs), with recommendations from previous users, welcoming staff, perceived spiritual protection, and past use being common reasons for utilization, while lower education and lack of health insurance predicted higher utilization of only TBA services.
